pages.title: Color Coin Merge
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Sort colored coins into slots and merge matching pieces in Color Coin Merge. Keep enough slots available for the coins still on the board, and use a power-up when a tricky arrangement leaves you short of space.

pages.title: Arrow Out
pages.creator: Imagine World Studios
pages.description: Work from the outside of each tangled shape in Arrow Out. An arrow can slide away when the space ahead of its tip is clear. Clear the ones that can move first, since tapping a blocked arrow costs a heart.

pages.title: SnakeLands.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Start as a small snake in SnakeLands.io and feed to grow while other snakes hunt in the same territory. Watch how rivals move, pick when to challenge them, and build up enough strength to evolve.

pages.title: Artillery Vs Tanks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Aim an artillery gun at incoming tanks before they reach your position in Artillery Vs Tanks. Take time to line up each shot, then spend rewards from successful battles on upgrades for the next attack.

pages.title: Sort Balls - Cones
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Rearrange colored balls among the tubes in Sort Balls - Cones until every tube holds just one color. Keep a little spare room for transfers and think through where each ball can go before you move it.

pages.title: Prison Master: Escape Journey
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Plan a way out of a high-security prison in Prison Master: Escape Journey. Work through the escape challenges in order and think ahead about how each choice affects your route to freedom.

pages.title: Road Of Fury 4
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Aim the convoy's weapons at attackers in Road Of Fury 4, a scrolling shooter set after the apocalypse. Recruit other nomads, improve your cars and guns, and save your special powers for tough fights along the 30-level route.

pages.title: VegaMix Match-3 Village
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Swap pieces to make matches and earn stars in VegaMix Match-3 Village. Spend the stars on tasks for Grandma and the villagers to find out more about her life and see how the village story develops.

pages.title: Tarcat
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Take control of a cat's paw in Tarcat and tap when it's lined up with a target. Look out for traps among the breakable objects, then time your swipes to clear everything the level asks you to hit.

pages.title: Mahjong 3D Match
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Turn the 3D pile in Mahjong 3D Match to see which pieces are hiding on the far side. Collect three identical pieces at a time and work through the whole pile before the timer expires.

pages.title: Cube Speed Dash
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Guide a cube through fast obstacle courses in Cube Speed Dash. Move from side to side and time your jumps as spikes and gaps approach. A collision or a missed landing brings the run to an end.

pages.title: Alien Intelligence Test
pages.creator: Maksim Popov
pages.description: Prove your intelligence to your alien captors by figuring out unfamiliar machines in Alien Intelligence Test. Experiment with the buttons, levers and switches, then use what happens on screen to work out how each puzzle operates.

pages.title: Contract Deer Hunter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Take hunting contracts across forests and open plains in Contract Deer Hunter. Locate the animal called for in each assignment, get a clear view, and line up an accurate shot to complete the contract.

pages.title: Merge Fusion
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Drag identical items together in Merge Fusion to turn them into the next item in the chain. Watch what each pair becomes and keep combining matching pieces as you work through progressively tougher levels.

pages.title: Warfare 1942 - online shooter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Join online firefights in Warfare 1942 - online shooter. Pick a soldier for the World War II battlefield, get familiar with your weapons, and watch where other players are moving as you fight to survive.

pages.title: Digital Circus Find The Differences
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Compare two versions of a colorful circus scene in Digital Circus Find The Differences. Look from one picture to the other and select small details that change, from parts of the characters to objects around them.

pages.title: Big Bad Ape
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Break out of the lab as a giant ape in Big Bad Ape and take your rampage into the city. Move through the streets and smash the objects you come across as the freed experiment wreaks havoc.

pages.title: Blocks Breaker
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Steer a tiny car and fire into walls of blocks in Blocks Breaker. Each block you destroy earns coins that can improve your car's rate of fire, helping you chew through more blocks on later runs.

pages.title: Cube Connect
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Slide track pieces into place in Cube Connect before the ball starts rolling. Build a route to the goal without a gap that can send it falling, and account for blocks that make it jump or warp.

pages.title: Real Parkour Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run, leap and climb through 3D parkour courses in Real Parkour Simulator. Look for the next platform as the route leads higher, and judge the timing of your jumps to stay on course.

pages.title: The Wall
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Pick zones on The Wall, then answer trivia questions and see where the balls land. The result of each drop affects how much you gain or lose, so every round combines your answers with a little luck.

pages.title: Princess Winter Ice Skating Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress Anna, Elsa, Moana, Ariel, Jasmine and Snow White for a skating outing in Princess Winter Ice Skating Outfits. Try clothes and coordinating accessories on each princess to give the group six different rink looks.

pages.title: Gold Strike Icy Cave
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Chip away at clusters of matching blocks in Gold Strike Icy Cave. Look for groups of frozen gems you can remove together and keep clearing room as the mine wall moves toward you.

pages.title: Forgotten Treasure 2 - Match 3
pages.creator: AnimaGames
pages.description: Match jewels to break obstacles and work through adventures in Forgotten Treasure 2 - Match 3. Collect treasures along the way or tackle a holiday quest to help a deer decorate its Christmas tree.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter - Classic Match 3 Pop Bubbles
pages.creator: Rendered Ideas
pages.description: Fire bubbles into the hanging cluster in Bubble Shooter - Classic Match 3 Pop Bubbles. Connect a shot to at least two bubbles of the same color to pop them, and finish clearing the screen before any reach the bottom.

pages.title: Instadiva Jenny Dress Up
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Style Jenny for a photo shoot in Instadiva Jenny Dress Up. Choose her hair, eyes and lashes, then put together an outfit with clothes and shoes that suit the look you want for the camera.

pages.title: Garden Tales Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Pair free tiles decorated with garden motifs in Garden Tales Mahjong. Use the puzzle selector to choose a layout, then look for pairs that open up more tiles so you can clear the arrangement.

pages.title: City Builder
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Tap to raise money in City Builder, then invest it in workers and equipment to grow your town faster. As your building operation expands, plant trees to give the new streets some greenery.

pages.title: Ball Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Slide movable tiles around fixed iron pieces in Ball Puzzle until there is a continuous track for the ball. Try to reach the goal with fewer moves, and use a hint if the board has you stuck.

pages.title: Solitaire 15in1 Collection
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Choose among 15 solitaire variants in Solitaire 15in1 Collection, including FreeCell and Klondike. Follow the rules of the current layout to move cards into place and see whether you can clear the deal.

pages.title: Football Juggle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose a foot and see how long you can keep the ball aloft in Football Juggle. Judge each kick by where the ball is falling so you can set up another touch instead of losing the streak.

pages.title: Emoji Maze
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Pick an emoji and navigate the corridors in Emoji Maze. Gather the likes scattered through each level, and keep an eye on the enemies so you can take a different turn before they catch you.

pages.title: Ikki Samurai Jump
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jump from floor to floor as a little samurai in Ikki Samurai Jump. Check the next platform for enemies before you leap, and keep climbing for as long as you can without touching one.

pages.title: Country Pop Stars
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Tay ready for her tour in Country Pop Stars. Try different dresses or tops and finish the stage outfit with boots and a hat that fit the country music look.

pages.title: Save The Queen
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pull the iron bars in the right order to help Olaf reach the princess in Save The Queen. Look for a way to use the puzzle mechanisms against the beasts before opening the path forward.

pages.title: RESOLVE a math game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Complete unfinished equations in RESOLVE a math game by linking the right numbers from the options above them. Work out what belongs in each gap and check how the numbers fit before making the connection.

pages.title: Two Lambo Rivals: Drift
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Slide through the streets of a Tokyo-inspired city in Two Lambo Rivals: Drift. Build up a drift score, collect and customize cars, or challenge a friend to see who can put together the stronger run.

pages.title: Xmas Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Remove matching pairs of holiday tiles in Xmas Mahjong Deluxe. You can pick uncovered tiles with an open side, so plan which pairs to take first as you work through 24 Christmas-shaped layouts.

pages.title: Puzzle Santa Dash
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move Santa beneath the bubbles in Puzzle Santa Dash and fire into groups of the same color. Three or more together will burst, giving you room to clear the rest before the bubbles reach the bottom.

pages.title: Color Maze Puzzle
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Roll a ball through the corridors in Color Maze Puzzle and paint every open square along the way. Work out a route through 80 layouts and unlock different balls as you finish levels.

pages.title: Virus Shot
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Watch the rotating syringe in Virus Shot and release a dose when it points toward a moving virus. Each miss brings the attempt closer to ending, with three misses allowed before the viruses win.

pages.title: Mahjong Digital
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Look for matching tiles in Mahjong Digital and choose pairs that free up the pieces around them. Work through the digital board one pair at a time until you can clear the full layout.

pages.title: Number Constellations
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Connect the numbered points from one through ten in Number Constellations. Each picture gives young players a chance to practice recognizing the digits and following the same counting order from the beginning.

pages.title: Chrome Dino Run
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Keep a pixel dinosaur running across the desert in Chrome Dino Run. Jump over each cactus as it approaches and earn a point for every one you clear before the run ends.

pages.title: Picture Slider Animals
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide scrambled tiles into place to reconstruct animal pictures in Picture Slider Animals. Pick an easy, medium or hard puzzle, then see how quickly you can get every piece back where it belongs.

pages.title: City Car Stunt 4
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take on stunt tracks or explore the city in Free Driving in City Car Stunt 4. Look for diamonds on rooftops and hills to unlock cars, and use blue teleport points to reach higher ground.

pages.title: Traffic Command
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Control the signals at busy intersections in Traffic Command. Decide when each lane should stop or move, and change the lights as traffic builds so you can keep cars flowing through the crossings.

pages.title: Little Animals Coloring
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Give the animals in Little Animals Coloring a new look with your virtual brush. Pick colors and apply them to the different areas of each picture, from the animals themselves to the details around them.

pages.title: Water Slide Car Stunts Racer
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a stunt car along tracks built like water slides in Water Slide Car Stunts Racer. Guide the car around the bends and keep it on the course as you race across the water.

pages.title: Wedding Planner
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Prepare a royal ceremony in Wedding Planner by decorating the couple's house and car. Design outfits for both the bride and groom and choose how the finishing touches come together for the celebration.

pages.title: Reckless Car Revolt : Highway Car Racer
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Weave through highway traffic and earn points in Reckless Car Revolt : Highway Car Racer. Put your earnings toward faster cars, and try to move up the weekly standings or take on the police race mode.

pages.title: Double Gun
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Fire your two guns at the objects in Double Gun. Time your shots to hit targets such as fruit, plants and burgers, and keep an eye out for what comes into range next.

pages.title: United Kingdom Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Flip cards to find matching pictures in United Kingdom Memory. Remember where you saw each image of British life and culture so you can clear all the pairs before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Carnival Balloon Shoot
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Take aim at the balloons in Carnival Balloon Shoot. Choose a target and click or tap to shoot at it, then move on to the next balloon on the carnival range.

pages.title: Valkyrie RPG
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore different worlds and pick up quests in Valkyrie RPG. Switch weapons, dodge attacks and use skills against the enemies you meet. Open your inventory or skill tree to check how your character is progressing.

pages.title: Count The Cards
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Count the cards on screen and enter your answer before the timer ends in Count The Cards. Accurate answers bring shorter time limits, so practice spotting the total quickly as the rounds progress.

pages.title: CS Clone
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Join a multiplayer room in CS Clone and fight other players across maps such as a desert, a temple, a factory or a container yard. Learn where each map gives you cover and room to move.

pages.title: Classic Scooter Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over tiles with scooter pictures in Classic Scooter Memory and remember which squares hide each design. Find all the matching pairs across four levels and try to finish with fewer flips.

pages.title: Mommy Cinderella Body Makeover
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Take Cinderella to the salon in Mommy Cinderella Body Makeover. Get her comfortable before the treatment, then pick a tanning shade and try out different decorative tattoos to finish her look.

pages.title: Gun Mayhem
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Fight to stay on the island in Gun Mayhem by knocking your opponents off the platforms. Pick a weapon that suits the match and grab falling crates for a chance to upgrade your firepower.

pages.title: Happy Fun Rider Wheels 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Guide a ragdoll rider over the obstacle course in Happy Fun Rider Wheels 2019. Use the arrow keys to drive and time your jumps with the space bar to make it to the finish.

pages.title: Thanks Giving Day Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of three holiday pictures in Thanks Giving Day Slide and put its scrambled tiles back in place. Switch between three puzzle modes to change how much of the picture you need to piece together.

pages.title: Path Paint 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Hold the mouse button or space bar to paint the road in Path Paint 3D. Control when you move forward and see whether you can carry the color all the way to the finish line.

pages.title: Basketball Smash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tap to lift the ball toward the basket in Basketball Smash. Keep making dunks as the timer counts down, and use well-timed taps to score more baskets and work toward unlocking different balls.

pages.title: Crazy Rushing Ball
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Steer your ball left and right in Crazy Rushing Ball as it races alongside other balls. Pick up coins, use speed boosts to close the gap, and try to get ahead of the pack.

pages.title: Farming Simulator 2
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive tractors through a series of field jobs in Farming Simulator 2. Follow the layout of each field as you work with crops and make the passes needed to finish the farming task.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot candy into a rotating wheel in Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel. Aim for groups of three or more matching colors and clear the entire wheel quickly, since your score drops as time passes.

pages.title: BTS Birds Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a bird drawing in BTS Birds Coloring Book and fill it in with your own colors. Change brush sizes to work on broad areas or small details, then save your finished artwork.

pages.title: Monster City
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a monster through the streets in Monster City. Attack with your claws or throw vehicles, and use your special attack when you need more power. Try the different skins as you take on more levels.

pages.title: Yatzy Challenge
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Roll the dice in Yatzy Challenge and lock the ones you want to keep before rolling again. Try for the highest score on your own, challenge the dice master, or play against friends.

pages.title: Little Cat Doctor
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Examine sick kittens and treat them in Little Cat Doctor. Use tools such as a thermometer to check each patient and follow the treatment steps to complete the clinic's missions.

pages.title: EG Toy Claw
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Position the crane over a toy in EG Toy Claw and use the claw to pick it up. Work through the prize puzzles and judge where to lower the claw in each new setup.

pages.title: Santa City Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide Santa through snowy streets in Santa City Run. Jump over cars and move around barricades while picking up presents for points. Collect elves for a temporary shield and spend what you earn on upgrades.

pages.title: Coloring Bear and Bunny
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Pick colors for a bear and a bunny in Coloring Bear and Bunny. Work through the picture at your own pace and see how different combinations change the look of the two animals.

pages.title: Cheerleaders School
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Lead a cheerleading team in Cheerleaders School and put on the figures the judges want to see. React to each prompt and keep the routine moving to impress the jury.

pages.title: Thatched Cottage Escape
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Search the rooms and inspect what you find in Thatched Cottage Escape. Follow the clues hidden among the cottage furnishings and use what you discover to unlock the exit.

pages.title: Red Carpet Couple
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help a royal couple get ready for a formal event in Red Carpet Couple. Start with the princess's makeup, then browse the wardrobe for a look she can wear on the red carpet.

pages.title: Bob The Robber 4 Season 3: Japan
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Sneak through buildings in Bob The Robber 4 Season 3: Japan. Watch for alarms as you make your way to each objective and use the on-screen tips to figure out how to get past security.

pages.title: Princesses Fashion Wars Feathers VS Deni
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Give Anna and Elsa competing looks in Princesses Fashion Wars Feathers VS Deni. Work with denim for one outfit and feathers for the other, and see how differently you can style the two trends.

pages.title: New Year Eve Party
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Get the Arendelle sisters ready for their New Year Eve Party. Give each one a distinct party look by choosing a sparkling outfit and coordinating it with jewelry and shoes.

pages.title: Royal Family New House Makeover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate the princess's new family home in Royal Family New House Makeover. Choose how to furnish the space and finish the look before the prince and their little one come home.

pages.title: Bonnie Movie Night
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Set up a cozy movie outfit in Bonnie Movie Night. Choose pajamas, adjust their colors, and give Bonnie a new hairstyle before adding accessories such as fluffy slippers, a headband or 3D glasses.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Party Dress!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two princesses run a Halloween shop in Princess Halloween Party Dress! Browse the festive clothing and pick out outfits to get the princesses ready for the holiday.
